builder_log.text:
BUILD INTENT: THE BRIDGE — span the hill instead of cutting it

OPERATION: Let the structure span so the building touches the ground in a handful of places instead of along a continuous wall. Utility core inside a rational skeleton; structure sets the dimensions.

REFERENCE IT COMES FROM: 20K Truss Home + 20K Bridge Home — light truss walls span the long dimension and continue into porch territory

DO NOT COPY: The 20K cost model. This is a mountain house with mountain loads — the borrowed idea is the span logic, not the budget.
THE TEST THIS SCHEME MUST PASS: Does spanning actually beat benching once you price the trusses against the earthwork it avoids?
Plan authored and machine-checked. 2 levels, 16 rooms accepted by tools/build-plans.mjs; 6 flags raised.
